fact: Ministry of Justice technical office head Wadie Hanna Nashed said a lawyers' platform gives digital PDF copies of court case files sent electronically, free hearing-date enquiries and SMS notice of court decisions.

Al Manassa reports the Ministry of Justice launched the E-Court platform on 31 August 2026, with a lawyers' services platform for first-instance criminal courts giving certified digital case-file copies, online fee payment and SMS of hearing decisions and dates.
